newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA OMIT CAMPESE FOR SCOTLAND TEST.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-AUSTRALIA OMIT CAMPESE FOR SCOTLAND TEST.

text.p: World record try-scorer David Campese has been omitted from the Australian side to meet Scotland at Murrayfield on Saturday.
Campese, who collected his 100th cap in the 40-18 win over Italy on October 23, makes way for Joe Roff.

Scrum-half Geroge Gregan has also been dropped with Sam Payne now partnering David Knox. Scotland have dropped Scott Hastings, their most capped player, and included flanker Murray Wallace in place of last year's injured captain Rob Wainwright.
Captain Gregor Townsend switches to the centres, allowing the selectors to recall Craig Chalmers to fly-half and restablish his old partnership with Gary Armstrong,

Scotland - Rowen Shepherd; Tony Stanger, Gregor Townsend (captain), Ron Eriksson, Kenny Logan; Craig Chalmers, Gary Armstrong; Eric Peters, Ian Smith, Murray Wallace, Damian Cronin, Doddie Weir, David Hilton, Kevin McKenzie, Barry Stewart.

Australia - Matthew Burke; Tim Horan, Daniel Herbert, Pat Howard, Joe Roff; David Knox, Sam Payne; Daniel Manu, David Wilson, Owen Finegan, John Eales (captain), Warwick Waugh, Andrew Blades, Michael Foley, Richard Harry.
